finding: The previous physical-material guard required exactly one ENTITIES callback. This safely refused a DXF with no ENTITIES section, but callback counts alone did not bind all physical records to the whole-file source inventory.
change: Advertise the existing optional whole-file physical identity source facet without changing codec vtables or binary implementation.

For bounded, explicitly opted-in replay, join each ENTITIES and BLOCK child physical record to the whole-file identity inventory by start/end ordinal. Require matching block begin/end and callback counts, at most one ENTITIES and BLOCKS section, a complete identity inventory and matching material handle/target snapshots.

Allow a genuinely absent ENTITIES section when the complete whole-file inventory proves it absent and all other replay gates pass; missing source evidence remains a refusal. Ordinary sparse-material replay remains guarded.
validation: Twelve focused system-codec MATERIAL cases pass 1923 assertions, including omitted ENTITIES in four generated AC1021 profiles; removed, duplicate, quota and altered-boundary identity reports; and removed BLOCK, child LINE and ENDBLK records. Each fault checks destination preservation and corrected same-filter reimport/retry.
Seven IMAGE cases pass 7512 assertions and the bundled-codec filter object compiles. The latter is a compile check rather than a full bundled runtime test.
Three existing focused codec transport tests pass for the whole-file identity inventory, ENTITIES and BLOCK children; the underlying codec implementation was unchanged by the new capability marker.

Independent ezdxf readback of the generated omitted-ENTITIES output found no model-space LINE, retained PlainMat and Sibling, and confirmed matching layer and current-material handles with zero audit errors or repairs. ezdxf adds its standard materials.
limits: Ordinal coverage and complete physical transport do not establish semantic delivery of every supported entity, complete graph identity, or native behavior.

This is a bounded explicitly opted-in AC1021 control. Other producers, versions, encodings and missing-section combinations need independent qualification. Multiple ENTITIES or BLOCKS sections and unavailable inventories remain conservatively refused.
The normal exporter and support claims remain unchanged. No generated drawing fixture was committed.
